name: FauxmoESP
description: fauxmoESP 3.4.1 (Amazon Alexa as a Belkin WeMo / Hue bridge) for ESPurna, the rtos branch: no Arduino framework and no Arduino layer under it - the platform is <espurna_base.h> of the library espurna-base (string, MD5, the station address and MAC; the firmware implements them), the SSDP listener on a lwIP udp_pcb on every chip; no TCP of its own: the application's web server hands the requests to process(isGet, url, body, reply), the answer comes back through the reply.
